changes.before: Partially superseded as of 2026-09-14. Colleton County Council unanimously adopted (third reading) a Digital Infrastructure Overlay District ordinance permitting data centers and battery energy storage systems, subject to conditions (300+ acre minimum, 65 dB noise cap, 200-ft buffers, closed-loop cooling), west of Interstate 95 and on land already zoned Light/Industrial/Industrial/Heavy Industrial; the moratorium (Ordinance 26-O-04) is repealed with respect to those areas but continues to apply elsewhere in the county (east of I-95, non-industrial-zoned land) through its original ~180-day term (adopted 2026-07-06, running to approximately 2027-01-02) absent further council action.
changes.after: On September 14, 2026, Ordinance 26-O-08 partially repealed the moratorium for areas west of I-95 and areas zoned LID, ID or HID; it states that the moratorium remains in effect east of I-95 outside those industrial zones until final approval of the specified comprehensive-plan update. Later actions and current force require further review.
